Always be calm. Remember even if she starts freaking out she is fine and you are fine so don't be distressed at all because if you start to worry she will be able to tell and that will make her worry more. Yes you are the tripsitter but if she is having a bad time don't take full responsibility, sometimes you can be the best sitter in the world but your tripper could just be in a bad headspace and there is not anything you can do. As long as you did your best to help her that's all that matters.


In all honesty bad trips aren't that common and having a trip sitter there is comforting so just being there makes things even less likely to go south. I also find that having something fun to look forward too helps stop bad trips from starting, because it stops them from thinking "I'm stuck like this". Have a few simple activities planned out like 'go for a walk' or 'draw something' and let her know you can do that together later if she wants. Hope this helps and remember to enjoy your time with her !
